newsitem.title: USA: Crescent buys facilities for $400 mln.
newsitem.headline: Crescent buys facilities for $400 mln.

text.p: Crescent Real Estate Equities Co said Tuesday it has completed the acquisition of 87 behavioral healthcare facilities from Magellan Health Services Inc in a deal valued at $400 million.
It said the facilities will be leased to and operated by Charter Behavioral Health Systems LLC, a joint venture between Magellan and Crescent Operating Inc.
In addition to the facilities, Crescent acquired warrants to buy about 1.3 million common shares of Magellan at $30 per share.
Crescent said the facilities will be leased to Charter Behavioral over an initial 12-year term for $41.7 million, subject to a 5 percent annual compounded increase.
The initial rental payment was increased from the previously announced amount as a result of two new facilities which were financed through the proceeds of Crescent's investment.
